svg.title: Beltline machine catalogue
svg.desc: One of each machine kind in the Beltline kit, joined by belts. Inserter arms load and unload the stores, a diverter flap picks a route, a hash pointer finds a bucket, and an LRU moves a node to the front of its list.
svg.text: Every kit machine with sample values. Illustrative, not a recording.

g.text: 1/11 an inserter lifts the item off the rack and onto the belt
2/11 ring buffer: c lands in the tail sector and the tail arm turns
3/11 hash map: h(k3) = 2, so the pointer drops to bucket 2
4/11 insertion sort: the arm lifts 3, 7 shifts right, and 3 goes in front
5/11 LRU: get(a) hashes to bucket 0 and finds node 2
6/11 the arm lifts a off the LRU end, the others slide down, a goes to MRU
7/11 the tokenizer cuts a number and hands it to the branch
8/11 branch: kind == num, so the flap swings to the upper route
9/11 the press renders a glyph and an inserter drops it on the plate
10/11 the next token is an operator
11/11 branch: else, so the flap swings down and the lock's gate turns
